motor_family: DM4340; RPO reference hardware is DM4340P 48V
status: simulation reference, not identified on user hardware

parameter_notes.armature: RPO feet/arms DelayedPDActuatorCfg and leg/arm_joint_param MJCF use 0.01. Do not infer it is manufacturer raw rotor inertia.
parameter_notes.passive_damping: RPO MJCF leg_joint_param/arm_joint_param damping=0.01; distinct from controller kv.
parameter_notes.urdf: Standard URDF stores passive dynamics damping; does not portably encode reflected rotor armature. Importer/training config must read this manifest for armature.
parameter_notes.candidate_0_032: Not enabled: requires interpreting older 2e-5 kg*m2 data as motor-side inertia and applying 40^2; no need to prefer it over the matched RoboParty simulation baseline.

velocity_limit_implementation.urdf: Declared joint velocity limit; importer must enforce it.
velocity_limit_implementation.usd_physx: Native PhysX joint/angular-axis velocity limit, 3 rad/s.
velocity_limit_implementation.mujoco_xml: Not a native hard constraint. Requires a matching control/actuator implementation; plain position actuators do not enforce 3 rad/s.
